items.title: Paul Barnes Interview, 1971-03-13
items.q: And Johnny Handley heard me play saxophone and he was so enthused over my saxophone playing that he put his clarinet down and he then got him a saxophone.

ctx.x: And Johnny Handley heard me play saxophone and he was so enthused over my saxophone playing that he put his clarinet down and he then got him a saxophone.
I never knew that. I didn't know he picked that up there.

items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-04
items.q: It looks something like Paul Bones, eh?

ctx.x: Say I wanted to show you this picture. That's what I've been looking for. Here's Earl Hines. Here's his sack section here. What is it? Uh... My glass. I was wondering if this was the guy. Any of these guys. That looks like Omar Simeon to me there. I don't know who that is. It's peach me.
It looks something like Paul Bones, eh? Mmhmm. I know it isn't though. No, that's not him though.
Well, I'll find a picture of the guy.
